What Changes When You Have an AiVA

## Stop Managing Tasks.  Start Running Your Business.

The average business leader spends 3+ hours a day on work that isn't their job. AiVA takes that back.

🎯

### Never Drop the Ball Again

AiVA tracks every task, deadline, and follow-up across all your conversations. When something needs doing, it flags it — or just handles it. No more sticky notes. No more "I forgot."

✍️

### Every Message, In Your Voice

Need to respond to 30 emails before lunch? AiVA drafts them in your tone, your style. Review and send, or let it handle the routine ones. Your clients won't know the difference — because it sounds like you.

🔎

### Research in Minutes, Not Hours

"Find me the top 5 competitors in this space." "What did our contract with Acme say about renewal terms?" AiVA searches, summarizes, and delivers answers — not links. Real answers you can act on.

📅

### Your Calendar, Under Control

Double-booked? Not anymore. AiVA manages your schedule, flags conflicts before they happen, and suggests optimal times. It learns your patterns — when you like meetings, when you need focus time.

🗺️

### From Big Idea to Action Plan

"I want to launch a podcast." AiVA turns that into 15 actionable steps with timelines, dependencies, and priorities. Big goals become manageable plans. Vague ideas become concrete next actions.

🧠

### It Gets Smarter Every Day

AiVA remembers your preferences, your projects, your people. It builds context over weeks and months. Six months in, it knows your business almost as well as you do — and it never forgets a detail.

Ridiculously Simple

## Up and Running Before Your Next Meeting

01

### Tell Us What You Need

A quick conversation about your workflow, your communication style, and the channels you live in — Telegram, WhatsApp, or Discord. We configure your assistant's personality to match yours.

02

### We Deploy Your Private Instance

Your AiVA runs on a dedicated server. Not shared. Not multi-tenant. Your data, your conversations, your business context — completely isolated. It's yours.

03

### Start Delegating

Send AiVA a message like you'd text a human assistant. "Remind me to follow up with Sarah on Thursday." "Draft a response to this email." "What's on my plate this week?" It just works.

Not a Chatbot

## The Difference Between Answering and Doing

Most AI tools answer questions. AiVA takes action. That's not a marketing line — it's an architectural decision.

### It Uses Real Tools

AiVA doesn't just generate text — it searches the web, creates documents, manages files, and sends messages on your behalf. When you say "find out," it actually finds out.

### It Remembers Everything

"You mentioned last Tuesday that the Acme deal was stalling because of pricing." AiVA builds a working memory of your world. No re-explaining. No lost context.

### It Lives Where You Do

Not another app to check. Not another dashboard to log into. AiVA meets you in Telegram, WhatsApp, or Discord — the tools already on your phone.

### It's Yours Alone

Every client gets a dedicated, isolated deployment. Your assistant doesn't share memory, context, or infrastructure with anyone else. Private by architecture, not just by policy.

Real Scenarios

## What Does a Day With AiVA Look Like?

7:30 AM

"Good morning. What do I need to know today?"

AiVA gives you a morning briefing: 3 meetings, 2 follow-ups due, 1 contract expiring this week, and a reminder that Sarah's birthday is tomorrow.

9:15 AM

"Draft a follow-up to the call with DataCorp yesterday. Mention the pricing discussion and suggest a Thursday demo."

AiVA drafts the email in your tone, references the specific points from yesterday, and asks if you want to send or edit first.

1:00 PM

"What are the top 3 project management tools for teams under 20 people? Compare pricing."

AiVA researches, compares, and delivers a summary table with pricing, key features, and a recommendation based on your team size.

4:45 PM

"Remind me to review the Q2 budget proposal Monday morning, and block 90 minutes for it."

Done. Calendar blocked, reminder set. AiVA will nudge you Monday at 8:30 AM with the document attached.
